name: Document Loader: Tool
description: Provides AI agent tool integration for the Document Loader module.
project_description: Document Loader: Tool exposes Document Loader to AI agents through the Tool module. A deriver creates one tool per source category (load_file, load_website, load_api, and any category a third-party input class adds), each with only the input definitions relevant to that source plus shared output_format and max_length. When executed, the tool delegates to DocumentLoaderManager::loadFromData() and returns the converted content, format, loader label, and metadata. A form_alter hook pre-configures loader options marked hide_from_llm_by_default as forced/hidden on the AI Agent, modeler, and API-explorer forms. Access is gated by the 'use document_loader tool' permission.
